name: video-player
title: Video Player
description: Custom video player with play/pause, a hover-expanding scrubber, mute, and Flip fullscreen expand animation.

usage.label: Astro
usage.code:
---
import "@/components/motion-blocks/video-player-element.ts";
---

<motion-video-player
  src="https://example.com/video.mp4"
  poster="https://example.com/poster.jpg"
  class="aspect-video w-full max-w-2xl rounded-xl overflow-hidden"
></motion-video-player>

usage.label: React
Vue
usage.code:
<script setup>
import "@/components/motion-blocks/video-player-element.ts";
</script>

<template>
  <motion-video-player
    src="https://example.com/video.mp4"
    poster="https://example.com/poster.jpg"
    class="aspect-video w-full max-w-2xl rounded-xl overflow-hidden"
  />
</template>

usage.label: Svelte
usage.code:
<script>
  import "@/components/motion-blocks/video-player-element.ts";
</script>

<motion-video-player

usage.label: HTML
usage.code:
<script type="module" src="/components/motion-blocks/video-player-element.js"></script>

<motion-video-player
  src="https://example.com/video.mp4"
  poster="https://example.com/poster.jpg"
  class="aspect-video w-full max-w-2xl rounded-xl overflow-hidden"
></motion-video-player>

props.name: src
props.description: URL of the video file to play.

props.name: poster
props.description: URL of the poster image to display before playback.

props.name: loop
props.description: Whether to loop the video when it ends.

props.name: hide-controls
props.description: Whether to hide all controls (play/pause, scrubber, etc.).
